nodes.label: Scheduling
nodes.detail: how work is assigned to the available resources (judged on resource utilization)
nodes.basis: keyword overlap with the problem statement + detected-domain affinity + editorial exploration priority (order only)
nodes.assumed_limitation: A single centralized scheduler must gather global state before it can decide, so its decisions are always slightly stale under fast-changing loads.

nodes.label: Computing Model
nodes.detail: what kind of computation the system performs and how (judged on achievable operations per second)
nodes.basis: keyword overlap with the problem statement + detected-domain affinity + editorial exploration priority (order only)
nodes.assumed_limitation: The dominant computing model is uniform and synchronous, so it spends energy on operations whose result the application does not actually need.

nodes.label: Runtime Adaptation
nodes.detail: how the system changes its own behaviour while running (judged on stability of achieved performance)
nodes.basis: keyword overlap with the problem statement + detected-domain affinity + editorial exploration priority (order only)
nodes.assumed_limitation: Design-time parameters are tuned for an average case, so the system is rarely at its best for the case actually running.

nodes.label: Data Representation
nodes.detail: how information is encoded, stored and transported (judged on information density per unit cost)
nodes.basis: keyword overlap with the problem statement + detected-domain affinity + editorial exploration priority (order only)
nodes.assumed_limitation: The representation is uniform across the whole tensor or molecule, so a few significant elements pay for many insignificant ones.

nodes.label: Heterogeneity-Aware GPU Scheduling
nodes.detail: Can capability-matched routing improve resource utilization for GPU made of deliberately non-uniform participants?

nodes.label: Decentralized GPU Scheduling
nodes.detail: Can decentralized coordination improve resource utilization for GPU in situations where a single centralized controller cannot observe the whole system quickly enough?

nodes.label: Alternative-Substrate GPU Compute Model
nodes.detail: Would moving the cost-dominant operation of GPU onto a different physical carrier improve achievable operations per second once interface overhead is included?

nodes.label: Oscillator-Synchronized GPU Compute Model
nodes.detail: Can emergent phase alignment replace an explicit global barrier to improve achievable operations per second for GPU?
